import pyspark.sql.functions as F
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

# Azure storage access info
blob_account_name = 'adlsfhirnonprod'
blob_container_name = 'raw'
blob_relative_path = '30tb'
linked_service_name = 'lsadlsfhirnonprod'

blob_sas_token = mssparkutils.credentials.getConnectionStringOrCreds(linked_service_name)

# Allow Spark to access Storage remotely

wasb_path = 'wasbs://%s@%s.blob.core.windows.net/%s' % (blob_container_name, blob_account_name, blob_relative_path)

spark.conf.set('fs.azure.sas.%s.%s.blob.core.windows.net' % (blob_container_name, blob_account_name), blob_sas_token)
print('Remote blob path: ' + wasb_path)

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + blob_account_name + ".dfs.core.windows.net/historic_data/Observation/"

df = spark.read.format("json").load(wasb_path + "/*/Observation.ndjson")

df = df.withColumn("issued", to_timestamp(col("issued")))
df = df.filter(F.col("issued") >= F.unix_timestamp(f.lit('2016-01-01 00:00:00')).cast('timestamp'))
df = df.filter(F.col("issued") <= F.unix_timestamp(f.lit('2020-12-31 23:59:59')).cast('timestamp'))

df = df.withColumn("year", date_format(col("issued"), "Y")) 
df = df.withColumn("month", date_format(col("issued"), "M"))
df = df.withColumn("day", date_format(col("issued"), "d"))

df.write.partitionBy("year").json(bronzePath)
